evals.name: message-from-staged-diff
evals.setup: A staged diff adding a JWT login endpoint: a new `handler/login.go` with `Login`, a `token.Issue` helper, and the route wired into the router. The conversation that produced it discussed session cookies at length — a design the diff does not contain.

evals.name: amend-from-hash
evals.setup: `HEAD` is a commit whose message reads "fixes". Its diff corrects an off-by-one in a pagination cursor. Separately, an unrelated `.gitignore` change is sitting staged in the index — content the message is not derived from.

evals.name: breaking-change
evals.setup: A staged diff removing the exported `Client.DoRequest` and folding its behaviour into `Client.Do`, with every internal caller updated.

evals.name: detail-matched-to-impact
evals.setup: A staged diff whose only effect is satisfying the linter: a package comment added, two identifiers renamed, one `#nosec` suppression. No behaviour changes.

evals.name: verbosity-arguments
evals.setup: One staged diff, invoked twice at different verbosities.

evals.name: apply-commits-without-confirming
evals.setup: A staged diff, with a harness attribution instruction active in the session asking for a `Co-Authored-By` trailer.

evals.name: empty-index-falls-back-to-unstaged
evals.setup: Nothing is staged. The working tree carries an unstaged change adding a retry to the HTTP client.

evals.name: fix-that-restores-promised-behavior-is-not-breaking
evals.setup: A staged diff fixing a bug where `ParseDuration` accepted a negative value the docs always said it rejected. Callers relying on the buggy acceptance will now get an error, so observable behaviour changes — but only to match what was already documented. No signature changes.
